title: Cornetist Chris Kelly and hall programs drawing crowds
summary: Bailey describes Chris Kelly, a cornetist at Perseverance Hall, and how programs posted on doors advertised bands by the cornet player's name.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
